steps: Close admission; fence new attempts and prove descendants quiescent before releasing pins or slots.
Stop only reviewed affected services, record failure evidence and service states.
For each journaled source/config/unit path compare installed release hash before restoring saved bytes/metadata; on external changes stop for review.
Quarantine release-created source files outside import paths; never remove arbitrary paths, jobs, cache objects or checkpoint data.
Restore prior unit/drop-in/offline environment/config identities; keep legacy/OFF/resource as approved fallback.

Keep additive schema only if old-version regression was proven. Never down-migrate or blindly replace live DB. Any DB restore needs stopped writers, separately retained failed state, matching manifest/checkpoint/object recovery point and explicit approval.
Restore originally active/enabled service states without enabling new services; verify legacy health before reopening admission.

steps.action: Re-probe all host identities, full mount tables, dependency compatibility, disk budgets and export exposure; resolve every gate; approve exact plan hash.
Use reviewed admission-maintenance provider; drain jobs and staging, verify leases/reservations and all descendants quiescent on all three workers. No forced termination of user jobs.

Create exclusive per-host snapshot/journal below planned namespace. Back up exact changed files, metadata, unit/drop-ins/config, offline environment identity and protected credential recovery. Record absent paths and original service states.

After drain proof, stop portal then dispatcher using listed argv. Verify no other SQLite writers; capture LOCAL SQLite backup with sqlite3.Connection.backup, FULL/FK and bounded busy handling, verify quick_check/foreign_key_check and an isolated restore. Record matching manifests, committed checkpoints and object references.

Transfer only role archive to its immutable release directory; verify digest and regular member allowlist before bounded extraction. Do not touch authoritative inputs, checkpoints, jobs, caches or active source yet. Provision pinned offline dependencies in a separate reviewed environment.

Rehearse listed additive migrations twice on a separate restored local DB copy; check row/state/lease and FK/schema invariants. After explicit DB-change approval, apply the same reviewed sequence to idle production DB; no job backfill, table repair or enum rewrite.

Stop idle agents only after quiescence. Journal/compare old file hashes and metadata, then publish only exact reviewed source files atomically; record intent before each operation and completion after fsync. Preserve unrelated files; proposed unit/config deltas remain unresolved and cannot be installed.

Start and verify pi01, pi02, pi03 agents; then portal and dispatcher using listed argv. Restore only originally enabled/active states; no enable/reboot/linger action inferred. Admission remains closed until acceptance.
Run approved disposable all-three acceptance; on any failure fence new attempts and execute reviewed rollback. Never disrupt unrelated students.
